name: pomodoro
description: ESP32 with an epaper display, that provides pomodoro functions

scripts.minify: node html/index.js && mv ./html/index.min.html ./data/index.html && mv ./html/settings.min.html ./data/settings.html && mkdir -p ./data/icons && cp ./html/icons/*.svg ./data/icons/
scripts.uploadfs: find ./data/ -maxdepth 1 -type f ! -name "*.gz" -exec gzip -f -k {} \; && pio run -e esp32dev -t uploadfs
scripts.datasize: find ./data/ -maxdepth 1 -type f ! -name "*.gz" -exec gzip -f -k {} \; && du -sb data | awk -v budget=1966080 '{pct=($1/budget)*100; printf "%d / %d bytes used (%.1f%%)\n", $1, budget, pct}'
